summary: This is a markdown document header that introduces a page about technologies and tools, specifically starting with information about Apache web server and its use in Docker containers.

explanations.1: The three dashes mark the beginning of YAML front matter, which is metadata that some markdown processors use to store document settings like title.
explanations.2: This line sets the document's title to 'Playing with slide-level' — it will be used by the markdown processor to identify the page.
explanations.5: The double hash creates a level-2 heading in markdown, making 'Technologies and tools' appear as a main section.
explanations.7: The triple hash creates a level-3 subheading, making 'Apache' a subsection under the technologies heading.
